title: Parkinson's Disease Treatment With Coenzyme Q10
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effects of varying dosage of coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) versus a placebo in the treatment of Parkinson's disease (PD) in patients with early, untreated PD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The subjects must have the three cardinal features of PD: slowness of movement, resting tremor and rigidity. The signs of PD must be greater on one side.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Disorders that mimic PD.
* Other serious medical problems.
